scope: Additive TB-CHI final-source gate after the official scores surface reached Final. Reuses the bound Week 9 baseline and Sunday pregame evidence, binds the exact final, complete final inactive lists, Chicago elevation and the literal injury annotations exposed by the lagging official live feed. At the observation cutoff the official recap payload still said INGAME, exposed no gameBookUrl and the stable gamebook asset returned HTTP 404. Starters, complete substitutes/participants, DNP, late injury/return, full specialist and official snap coverage remain explicit UNRESOLVED fields. No started-game prediction, fair, carried rating or market field is changed.
estimationPolicy: Factual preparation only. Missing participation, exposure, replacements and values are not zero. A scores-page Final does not supply a complete final gamebook. No new numerical method is authorized.
